messages:
Samir (AE): Heads-up — CharterPay POC kickoff 3/14. Goal: live streaming + function/tool calls + structured JSON output for transaction normalization. We need SDK guidance, a short runbook for the streaming handshake, and answers for their security questionnaire. Can we align?
Maya (Solutions Eng): +1. I'll own SDK examples (Go + Python) and a minimal replayable test harness. Who's handling KMS/SSO questions?
Samir (AE): Tara please for security Qs. CharterPay asked about required SOC2 controls and key management for dedicated/private. Also pricing: they asked about reserved capacity vs burst pricing — need rough numbers to scope a proposal.
Tara L. (Security): I can take the questionnaire. Ping me the doc when it's ready. For KMS we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private and Dedicated; hosted offers encryption-in-transit + server-side keys. I'll draft a short blurb.
Oliver K.: For streaming + function calls — simplest pattern is SSE (client) -> Redwood streaming -> model with tool/function JSON outputs. If the client can't parse partial JSON chunks we recommend framed messages. Example (Go client):
```go
// connect to streaming endpoint, print events
resp, _ := http.Get("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-large")
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
  fmt.Println(scanner.Text()) // each line is an event/frame
}
```
Maya (Solutions Eng): Also adding a tiny example for function/tool calls in Python (structured output):
```python
# request body snippet
{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Normalize transaction: \"Amt: $12.50; Date 01-08-24\""}], "tools": ["tx-normalizer-v1"]}
```
Maya (Solutions Eng): We should include a schema we return so their parser can immediately map fields. I'll attach JSON Schema in the runbook.
Samir (AE): Pricing note from CharterPay: they expect 100k tokens/day in steady-state, spikes to 300k. Can you give a ballpark for hosted vs dedicated? Need it for SOW draft.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: hosted ~ $0.0008/token generation (depends on model); dedicated reserved nodes could drop unit costs ~40% but needs a 3-6 month commit. I'll scribble numbers and caveat model/quantization impact.
Tara L. (Security): Quick checklist for the questionnaire: SOC2 status (we have), data residency (EU region options), customer-managed KMS availability, audit logs retention, and optional on-prem installer for air-gapped reviews. I'll prepare statements for each.
Samir (AE): Great. Can we aim to have: runbook + SDK snippets + security blurb + pricing ballpark by EOD tomorrow? Client call scheduled 3/15.
Oliver K.: I can draft the streaming handshake doc tonight — will include backpressure notes and how to fall back to non-streaming. For structured output, recommend using `event.type` framing: `partial_output`, `final_output`, `tool_call`.
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll produce Go + Python minimal examples, plus a tiny NodeJS snippet showing function-call handling.
Tara L. (Security): I'll upload the completed questionnaire answers to the Deal folder and @Samir notify when done.
deploy-bot: Runbook template created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/charterpay-poc (permissions: sales+solutions).
Samir (AE): Perfect — thanks all. If anyone hits blockers (SSO cert rotation, ephemeral creds for streaming), flag here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Oliver K.: One note on structured output: if you need strict JSON per event use base64-encoded payloads in each frame to avoid stream chunking issues. I can add that as an appendix.
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll include a sample test harness that validates the schema and simulates 500 RPS for their perf expectations.
Samir (AE): Awesome. I'll update CharterPay with expected deliverables and confirm the 3/15 tech sync.
Tara L. (Security): FYI Legal may ask for a copy of our pen test report — I'll pre-request it.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Done — pushing drafts to the deal folder.
Samir (AE): Last thing — can someone add a short FAQ about fallback routing (model variant fallback) for the SOW? They care about availability and graceful degradation.
Oliver K.: On it. Will note automatic fallback to smaller/quantized variants and multi-region routing.
Maya (Solutions Eng): OK closing loop. Will post final bundle in the channel when ready. :rocket:
